name: Optimizing Aether for world-class research output

description: Baseline: pipeline scans 2687 files, 19 sorries, quality scoring works. Substantial scores ~0.96-1.0, partial ~0.56, trivial ~0.16. Strategy analysis empty (0 experiments). Context minimal.

Implemented Aristotle Loop: UCB prompt selection, cross-domain synergy matrix, diminishing returns detection, Jaccard novelty scoring, enhanced quality evaluation with depth/cross-domain/open-problem bonuses, improved Pi-Agent system prompts with world-class research principles

Added Aristotle Loop simulation (UCB domain selection, cross-domain synergy matrix, bridge detection from catalog imports), catalog analyzer cross-domain bridge detection (only 12/78 domain pairs connected), missing bridge recommendations integrated into orchestrator. Quality scoring now differentiates substantial (0.975-1.0) from trivial (0.0-0.025) with clean separation.

Final optimization: enhanced sorry_fill mode with detailed proof strategy hints for Carmichael and Fibonacci targets, improved quality evaluation with theorem_count/sorry_count/has_cross_domain/advances_open_problem, Jaccard novelty detection, Aristotle Loop UCB selection with diminishing returns and bridge detection, cross-domain synergy tracking (2.8x superadditivity), 12/78 existing bridges with top missing: Algebra-Physics (97), Algebra-EML (94). 8/8 checks pass.

Plus AristotleLoopVerification.lean with 15 more theorems. Total new declarations: 28 across 2 new files. 8/8 checks pass.

Fixed critical bug: Aristotle prompt now addresses the theorem prover directly ('## Research Task: title') instead of sending the meta-instruction 'Write a research brief for Aristotle...'. This means Aristotle receives actionable task instructions, not instructions for a third party. Added preamble stripping for LLM-generated prompts. Added Check 9 to validate prompt structure. 9/9 checks pass.
